snippet.title: Asterfel - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Shipwrecked. Alone. And free to choose your own path.

Asterfel is a third-person Action RPG inspired by classic early 2000s RPGs, where you explore a dark open world at your own pace with no hand-holding and no predetermined path.

Begin as a nameless shipwrecked outsider and forge your own journey across an island shaped by greed, conflict and unstable magic. Wield swords and bows or harness magical runes, combine different combat styles, craft your own equipment and grow from a vulnerable survivor into a powerful adventurer.

Choose where you stand between three rival factions: the King's Crown Wardens, the rebellious Kindred and the magic-seeking Scholars. Your allegiances matter, offering different playstyles and perspectives on a conflict that has awakened mutated horrors, the restless dead and an ancient god.

Explore deserts, dense jungles and ancient ruins, discover Corruption Rifts and gather Mystical Ore to craft some of the most powerful equipment Asterfel has to offer.

Wishlist Asterfel now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3892510/Asterfel/

Coming to PC and consoles in Q1 2027.

Play Asterfel at gamescom 2026 at the Home of Indies booth in Hall 10.2, Booth E010g-D011g.
